globalThis.comparison = (async () => {
  const face = new FontFace('NimboScripts', 'url(/font-scripts-assets/' + variant + ')');
  document.fonts.add(face);
  await face.load();
  const size = 10 + variant;
  const near = (actual, expected) => Math.abs(actual - expected) < 0.001;
  // Chromium rounds each shaped text fragment to 1/64 px layout units.
  const nearBox = (actual, expected) => Math.abs(actual - expected) <= 2 / 64 + 0.000001;
  const context = new OffscreenCanvas(8, 8).getContext('2d');
  context.font = size + 'px NimboScripts';
  const checks = {};
  const cases = [
    ['greek', 'Αα', 1150],
    ['cyrillic', 'Жж', 1470],
    ['hebrew', 'אב', 1160],
    ['hebrewWords', 'אב אב', 2570],
    ['arabicIsolated', 'ب', 400],
    ['arabicPair', 'بب', 720],
    ['arabicJoining', 'بلا', 820],
    ['arabicSpace', 'ب ب', 1050],
    ['latinArabic', 'Aب', 1000],
    ['hebrewNumbers', 'אב 11', 2450],
    ['latinKernInHebrew', 'אBA', 1840],
    ['arabicLatinArabic', 'ببAبب', 2040],
    ['mixedScripts', 'AΑЖאب', 3030],
  ];
  for (const [name, text, units] of cases) checks[name] = near(context.measureText(text).width, units * size / 1000);
  const box = document.createElement('span');
  box.style.cssText = 'display:inline-block;white-space:nowrap;font:' + size + 'px NimboScripts';
  document.body.append(box);
  for (const [name, text, units] of cases.slice(4, 8)) {
    box.textContent = text;
    checks['box' + name[0].toUpperCase() + name.slice(1)] = nearBox(box.getBoundingClientRect().width, units * size / 1000);
  }
  box.dir = 'rtl';
  box.textContent = 'אב 11';
  checks.boxRtlNumbers = nearBox(box.getBoundingClientRect().width, 2450 * size / 1000);
  box.remove();
  return checks;
})();
